description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'TaskEditDialogFragment' which provides a user interface dialog for adding or editing tasks in a task organizer app. It manages task data input including title, description, and due date, and interacts with a ViewModel for data operations.

classes.name: TaskEditDialogFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment subclass for adding or editing tasks, managing user input, and communicating with the ViewModel for persistence operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel and loads existing task data if editing an existing task.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and configures the dialog UI, including handling date picking, validation, and save/cancel actions.

methods.name: updateDueLabel
methods.description: Updates the displayed due date label based on the selected date or clear state.
